1.title: Trump Rejects Talk of A.I. Regulation and Calls Out Anthropic’s CEO
1.summary: The president again rejected calls to try to regulate the industry, even as some of its leaders are speaking more openly about the risks of rapidly developing artificial intelligence.

2.title: States and Cities Sue Over Trump’s Policy to Restrict Green Cards
2.summary: The policy would give immigration officers wide authority to deny green cards to people using public benefits.

3.title: As Immigrants Seek Legal Status, Redacted Documents Doom Their Chances
3.summary: Many noncitizens need immigration records the government has to prove their legal stay and resist deportation. The government is redacting and withholding those documents, lawyers say.

4.title: Russian Strike on Train Station Near Ukraine-Poland Border Seen as Warning to Kyiv’s Allies
4.summary: The attack on Ukraine’s rail network, which connects the country to the West, was a jab at Europe, officials said.

5.title: Saudi Leader Meets U.S. Commander as Houthi Attacks Threaten Oil Markets
5.summary: Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman asked the United States for more U.S. military help last week after the Iranian-backed Houthi forces in Yemen launched a broad offensive.

6.title: Africa's richest man launches continent's biggest share sale
6.summary: Nigerian billionaire Aliko Dangote says he wants ordinary people to share in the success of his oil refinery.
